basic_details.post_name: Assistant Architect Planner, Sports Officer, Programmer Grade-2
basic_details.short_information: Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has invited applications for 25 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. A-5/E-1/2026. The posts include Assistant Architect Planner, Sports Officer, Programmer Grade-2. The online application is open from 4 November 2026 to 4 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UPPSC Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit the commission's website https://uppsc.up.nic.in and complete One Time Registration (O.T.R.). Click on 'Apply' and authenticate with O.T.R. Fill essential qualifications and submit details in Application Part-2. Pay the application fee through SBI MOPS and take print of Payment Transaction Slip and Application Form. Apply on or before 4 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates must ensure preservation of information of all stages for future references. Hard copy of documents should not be sent to the commission at the preliminary exam stage.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for UPPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 4 December 2026. Applications opened on 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in UPPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 25 vacancies: 8 Assistant Architect Planner, 16 Sports Officer, 1 Programmer Grade-2.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for UPPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Unreserved / EWS / OBC: Rs. 225. Scheduled Castes / Scheduled Tribes: Rs. 105. Persons with Disabilities (PWDs): Rs. 25. Ex-Servicemen: Rs. 105.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is have attained the age of 21 years and must not have crossed the age of 40 years on July 1, 2026 (as on 1 July 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC of U.P. 5 years, PH of U.P. 15 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 15,600-39,100 , Grade Pay: 5,400 , Level-10 for Assistant Architect Planner, Rs. 47,600-151,100 , Level-8 for Sports Officer, Rs. 9,300-34,800 Grade Pay-4600 for Programmer Grade-2.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor Degree in Architecture, Post Graduate Degree/Diploma, Graduation in relevant fields. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Mandatory to make One Time Registration (O.T.R.) before applying online. Caste certificates for women candidates from father side only will be treated valid. Reservation benefits applicable only to permanent residents of U.P.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates appearing in the Examination of essential qualification prescribed for the post need not apply.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Preliminary Examination. Main Examination / Direct Recruitment based on marks. Document Verification. Selection will be made on the basis of marks obtained by the candidates in the examination.
